towns.name: Yaraq
towns.summary: Yaraq (21.6S 1.7W) is one of the four starter towns: desert-dwelling Gharu'ndim led by the wizard Raqur al-Hayra crossed the A'mun Desert to this cove on the east shore of the Inner Sea, where Raqur thrust his staff into the ground and brought forth fresh water; he died in a duel with a Mu-miyah archmage before the town was finished. Yaraq stands on a grassy terrace (z 10-12) above a sandy beach: a long plaza with two pools, the nullified drudge statue on its pillar, the Life Stone and a crystal cluster at the Destroyed Portal to Greenspire, faced by an east row of yellow-green domes, rooftop-garden houses and a stained-glass church tower, and the Town Network portal beyond. On the beach a bamboo fishing hut has a pier into the sea; to the south a fountain stands under a great tree beside an orchard; north-east rises a lone five-storey spire tower, east is Arshid's Den of Iniquity with blue lantern poles, and further east a bonfire burns at an octagon watchtower.
